title: CLI agents and Hermes reach the tool registry in agent mode
user_story: As the owner I want Codex, Claude Code and Hermes to work as real agents in PhD Lab, bounded only by the tool permissions I grant, so a full research-to-paper flow runs from chat.

requirements.description: In tool_mode=agent a CLI or runtime agent turn receives the phdlab_tools_* meta-tools and a session token whose registry scope is the owner's agent profile (narrowed by an explicit session list); legacy mode keeps the read-only MCP allowlist.
A Topic chat hides the project-scope MCP tools (memory, files, sandbox) but keeps the registry; an explicit ["-"] still removes every tool. App and CLI agents use the same scope.

With workspace_write in the agent profile the CLI writes its own session workspace (assisted profile, as Hermes) only where the provider enforces that isolation; otherwise the review workspace stays read-only.
Inside the PhD-Lab container Codex runs without its own bubblewrap sandbox (the container is the boundary); other connectors are unchanged.
The AI tools tab offers every backend permission, including process and reasoning (frontend/src/features/settings/AiToolsSettings.test.tsx).

nonfunctional: No availability probe per chat turn
No new permission is granted by default
postconditions: phdlab_tools_call runs only registry tools inside the grant and the profile permissions
acceptance_criteria: Agent-mode CLI lists and runs registry tools over the real MCP handler
Registry scope narrows what phdlab_tools_call may run
Topic chats never see project-scope tools
Codex shell works inside the container
Live: Codex discovered papers, wrote experiment code and ran missions through PhD Lab tools

scenarios.expected: tools/list shows the meta-tools; phdlab_tools_call runs a registry tool
Legacy mode keeps the read-only allowlist without meta-tools
A grant issued without a registry scope keeps its own tool list
A tool outside the registry scope is denied
Topic: only meta-tools over MCP; registry excludes project-scope tools
App agent gets the same Topic scope
Grant computation never probes tool availability
Without workspace_write the workspace stays review
--sandbox becomes danger-full-access inside the container; review stays review
Resume form sandbox_mode is rewritten too
Other connectors keep their sandbox flags
Every backend permission has a toggle
A provider without enforced assisted isolation keeps review but still gets the registry

recovery: Fix the grant, not the boundary. TASK-CLI-AGENT-REGISTRY-662, max three cycles.
test_environment: Real policy, MCP JSON-RPC handler, registry and runtime with a disposable PHDLAB_DATA_DIR; Docker, the CLI binary and the model are not started. Live acceptance with Codex (ChatGPT sign-in) recorded in docs/qa/evidence/cli-agent-registry-662/live-codex.md.

tdd.scope: RED: 13 FAIL on c7a7d9f (bugs found by the live Codex run). GREEN: 15/15 PASS.
